title: Quick Smoky Brazilian Chicken Skewers
description: Sweet and smoky chicken skewers with a Brazilian twist, perfect for a brunch gathering, featuring red pepper paste and a dash of friendly flavors, this dish is sure to delight your taste buds with its snappy texture and mushimono-steam cooking method.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together red pepper paste, olive oil, garlic, salt, black pepper, and paprika.
Add the chicken to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated chicken onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until the chicken is cooked through.
While the chicken is cooking, prepare the mushimono-steam by bringing a pot of water to a boil.
Once the chicken is done, brush with lemon juice and serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley.
For an extra smoky flavor, let the skewers rest for a few minutes before serving.
